_doc: The dashboard's registry. Each entry becomes an item in the left sidebar and a route at /<id>. `scripts` is what a refresh runs, in order, from the repo root — omit it for a report that is written by hand or produced by something outside this repo, and it will be served without a refresh button rather than pretending it has one. `data` is the JSON whose collectedAt drives the age indicator; omit it and the report's own file mtime is used instead. Any reports/*.html not listed here still appears in the sidebar as unregistered, so a new report is reachable the moment it exists — adding it here is what gives it a title, a group, and a refresh.
_groupsDoc: `groups` orders the sidebar sections; a report names one via `group`. A report whose group is missing from this list still renders, under its own heading at the end — an unknown group must not hide a report.
_appsDoc: `apps` lists which apps a report can say anything about, using config/apps.json ids. The sidebar's app filter uses it two ways: it dims a report that covers none of the selected apps, and inside a report it shows only the [data-app-scope] blocks for selected apps. A report with no `apps` key is treated as covering all of them, so the filter can never silently hide a lane it does not understand.
